title: Shared pet record across Shelter and Pet Care
summary: Pets are now shared between APES Shelter and Rescue and APES Pet Care Clinic. A pet added in either service shows in both, and can have a consultation or a shelter case.
changes: Pet Profiles in Shelter and Pet Care now show the same shared list of pets.
Pet Care consultations can be booked for any pet, including pets first added in Shelter.
Shelter cases can be linked to any pet, including pets first added in Pet Care.
Each service's own permissions still decide who can see and change a pet there.
Existing pets stay as they are and now appear in both services.
version_rationale: Patch: changes which pets each service lists, with no schema change and no data change.
validation: New feature test for shared lists, consultations, cases, existing pets and privacy between owners.
Pet, case, consultation, dashboard and authorisation tests updated for shared pets.
known_limitations: Service dashboards still count pets by the service where they were first added.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. Pets go back to showing only in the service where they were added; consultations and cases linked across services stay in the database.
provenance: Milestone v0.50.2 Beta, issue #482 under epic #481, pull request #623.
